title: Brand-new purchase and brand perception
summary: Reviews in this topic center on buying the car brand new and broader brand expectations, with some praise for BMW’s brand appeal but several comments expressing disappointment that a new car or the brand did not meet expectations.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise BMW as a preferred brand and describe strong brand loyalty or approval.

negative.summary: Negative reviews focus on disappointment that a brand-new car fell short of expectations and, in one case, led the owner to consider switching brands.

mixed.summary: The mixed review contrasts a generally strong view of the brand with disappointment about the actual experience.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mainly mention buying the car brand new or refer to the brand in passing, and the sample is often too brief to infer a clear sentiment about this topic.

limitations: This cluster mixes purchase-context mentions of a brand-new car with broader statements about brand perception, so not all fragments reflect the same underlying issue.
Most sampled undetermined fragments are short or contextual mentions, which limits confidence in drawing a more specific topic interpretation.
